result.title: Refined Grid Sampling for Efficient Implicit Neural Representations of Large-Scale Scientific Data
result.summary: Implicit neural representations (INRs) offer a powerful framework for modeling high-dimensional physical fields, but their training remains inefficient because evaluating dense coordinate grids is computationally expensive. Existing coordinate-pruning strategies rely on local error functions that can oversample correlated points and incur substantial overhead from full-grid error evaluation. We introduce Refined Grid Sampling (RGS), which combines stratified grid sampling, error-based refinement, and dynamic grid-resolution adjustment. This design reduces spatial redundancy without evaluating errors over the full grid. On high-resolution Navier--Stokes fields, RGS achieves higher reconstruction accuracy within a fixed wall-clock budget and reaches the accuracy of full-grid training up to $6\times$ faster than the evaluated baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 论文为大尺度科学场的隐式神经表示提出 Refined Grid Sampling，用分层网格采样、基于误差的精化和动态网格分辨率调整替代全网格误差评估，在固定时间预算下提升 Navier–Stokes 场重建精度与训练效率。
